commands.checkAll: Check health of all AI providers

intro: Connect AI services through official mechanisms only: API keys (kept in the OS secret vault), the official Claude Code and Codex CLIs with your own login, or local endpoints such as Ollama. Prices shown are estimates.
connectingHint: Provider settings load once the core is reachable.

auth.notInstalled: not installed (`{{binary}}` was not found on PATH)

OpenAi.description: OpenAI API (Chat Completions, streaming, tools, structured output).
OpenAi.signInNote: ChatGPT account sign-in is not offered to third-party apps. Use an API key, or the Codex CLI for subscription access.

Anthropic.signInNote: Claude subscription access goes through the official Claude Code CLI provider.

Ollama.description: Local models via Ollama — nothing leaves this machine.

OpenAiCompatible.name: OpenAI-compatible
OpenAiCompatible.description: Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint (LM Studio, vLLM, gateways) with an optional key and headers.

Custom.name: OpenAI-compatible
Custom.description: Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint (LM Studio, vLLM, gateways) with an optional key and headers.

ClaudeCode.description: The official Claude Code CLI with your own signed-in session (subscription or API).
ClaudeCode.loginInstructions: Install the official CLI (npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code), run `claude` in a terminal and complete its login (/login). Orkestr never reads the CLI's credentials.

Codex.description: The official Codex CLI with your own signed-in session (ChatGPT plan or API key login).
Codex.loginInstructions: Install the official CLI (npm install -g @openai/codex), then run `codex login` in a terminal. Orkestr never reads the CLI's credentials.

Mock.name: Mock (offline demo)
Mock.description: Deterministic offline demo provider: scripted plans, tool calls and structured output. No network, no keys.

form.name: Name
form.apiKeyHint: Stored in the OS secret vault. Never shown again and never logged.
form.apiKeyRequired: Paste your API key. It is stored in the OS secret vault, never in the database.
form.cliNote: Orkestr runs the official {{binary}} CLI with your own signed-in session. Credentials stay with the CLI.

instance.subscription: Subscription (usage is tracked, cost is not metered)

settings.keySaved: API key saved to the secret vault.

models.title: Models
models.empty: The provider did not report any models. Type a model id into “Default model”.

validation.credentialHeader: “{{name}}” carries a credential. Use the API key field instead (it is stored in the secret vault).
validation.baseUrl: Use a full http:// or https:// URL.
validation.managerModel: Choose a model for the Manager.
validation.parallelAgents: Max parallel agents must be a whole number from {{min}} to {{max}}.
validation.timeLimit: The time limit must be from 1 to 1440 minutes.
validation.fallbackModel: Every fallback entry needs a model.
validation.fallbackLimit: The fallback chain can hold at most {{max}} models.
validation.routingModel: Every routing rule needs a model.

manager.intro: The AI Manager plans the work, spawns agents and reviews their results. Choose its model, its limits and what happens when a provider is rate-limited or out of quota. Every model switch is announced.
manager.noProviders: No providers yet. Add one under “AI Providers” first.
manager.instructionsPlaceholder: Extra guidance for the Manager, e.g. “Prefer small PRs and always add tests.”
manager.fallbackHint: Tried in order, with a structured handoff, when the main model is rate-limited, out of quota or failing.
manager.noFallbacks: No fallbacks: a failure stops the run and asks you what to do.
manager.routingAutoHint: Scores capability, cost, latency and limits; rules get a boost.
manager.noRules: No routing rules: every role uses the Manager’s choices.
manager.noRulesAuto: No routing rules: every role uses the Manager’s choices and automatic scoring.

claudeEngine.title: Claude Code (subscription)
claudeEngine.subtitle: Run the AI Manager, agents, reviews and consensus on your Claude Code subscription through the official CLI. Orkestr never reads its credentials.
claudeEngine.notSignedIn: Not signed in to Claude Code
claudeEngine.hint: Sets the Manager, every agent role, review, consensus and PM to Claude Code. Your current models stay as fallbacks.
claudeEngine.applied_one: Done: the Manager and {{count}} role now use Claude Code.
claudeEngine.applied_other: Done: the Manager and {{count}} roles now use Claude Code.
